Hello, I'm Tari Utami.

Warranty professional with more than 7 years of experience at an authorized Mercedes-Benz dealer, backed by an automotive mechatronics background. I manage the warranty claim process end to end through the DMS, with a 0% rejection-rate KPI in line with Mercedes-Benz standards.
